NECK AND BACK. [31] [Chel.]
Drawing in nape and occiput. θ Influenza.
Left half of nape of neck stiff, during periods of exacerbation, head drawn across to left, nape feels as if broken. θ Prosopalgia.
Cervico-bronchial neuralgia.
Neck feels as if constricted or tied with a napkin.
Stiffness of cervical muscles.
Pain in right cervical muscles, and in region of right clavicle.
Sharp, shooting pain in left side of neck and across temple and over eye ; liver sore to touch, with nausea.
Pressive pain in muscles of left side of neck.
Heaviness and tension in muscles of nape of neck and in occiput.
Stiffness : of neck ; of muscles of right side of neck.
Stiffness of neck : on moving head ; with painfulness on deep breathing ; with cracking of vertebræ on moving neck.
Stitches beneath right scapula.
Constant pain under lower inner angle of right shoulder blade, extending into chest or stomach, causing nausea and vomiting. θ Amenorrhœa. θ Pregnancy.
Fixed pain under inner and lower angle of right shoulder blade, with frightful cough, diarrhœa and exhaustion.
Pressing and oppression in right scapula, extending through thorax to sternum.
Violent pains at lower angle of left scapula.
Pain at outer margin of left scapula.
Violent pains in right shoulder joint, whence they have extended from scapula.
Percussion dull under left shoulder blade, covering size of a hand.
Violent tearing pains in back and limbs ; < from least touch. θ Acute rheumatism.
Violent pains in back from nape to sacrum.
Pains in right side of back, with painful feeling in occiput, pressing aching towards left ear. θ Hepatitis.
Pinching, cramplike pain in internal border of right scapula, with a kind of pressing stitch from left side of occiput to forehead.
Pain in spine between shoulders.
Percussion gives a dull sound on each side of spine. θ Pneumonia.
Drawing, stiffness and stitches in muscles of back ; pain as after excessive exertion.
Burning in back.
Shivering running down back.
Violent pain in back. θ Influenza.
Sensation as if vertebræ were being torn apart when stooping forward, and then bending backward again ; also when walking.
Pain like a wound in lower dorsal vertebræ and five lowest ribs on right ; < by pressure and movement.
Pain as though lower lumbar vertebræ would separate, when bending forward.
Tearing in lower lumbar vertebræ, extending to iliac bones.
Drawing pain in back and sacrum. θ Liver affection.
Pain in sacrum.
Painful drawing in back and limbs. θ Hepatic typhus.
Drawing from sacrum to right side of scrobiculum. θ Gastralgia.
Aching soreness in all the vertebræ ; < by motion and by pressure on spinous processes.
Red miliary eruption on neck, chest and arms. θ Acute rheumatism.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Chel.]
Fixed pain under inner angle of right scapula ; often accompanies cough, diarrhœa, pneumonia, menses, loss of milk, exhaustion, etc.
Tearing pain in shoulder and right arm on moving arm.
Pain in right shoulder.
Drawing pain from right shoulder down to wrist, with coldness and stiffness of arms.
Pain in left shoulder as if sprained or fractured, with cold feeling in upper arm.
Pain in left shoulder, extending into deltoid muscle.
Paralytic pain in left shoulder and in whole of left arm.
Inability to use right arm and forearm with much freedom, sometimes attended with tearing pain.
Lancinating pains in upper extremities.
Pain directly over left elbow joint.
Repeated twitching in right arm.
(In sick :) Swelling of elbows as in acute rheumatism. θ Toothache.
Elbows swollen. θ Acute rheumatism.
Stiffness in wrist.
Stitches in right wrist.
Hands hot up to middle of forearm, swollen, with distension of superficial veins.
Drawing pain in dorsum of left hand.
Tearing in metacarpals and tips of fingers, right side ; < by pressure.
Joints of fingers right hand yellow, cold, nails blue.
Stabbing, drawing pain in left index finger.
Tips of fingers cold.
Rheumatic attacks of upper extremities, with black jaundice. θ Hepatic calculus.
Paralytic heaviness of arms as if weights were hung upon them.
Pain in left shoulder, with want of power in left arm, which must be kept close to body, because any attempt to move it causes a sensation as if left shoulder was breaking off. θ Prosopalgia.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Chel.]
Shooting pain in right hip, extending into abdomen, with heat and anxiety. θ Liver complaint.
Pains in right hip when rising from a seat.
Shooting pain in hip joint.
Drawing pain in hips, thighs, legs and feet, more right side.
Bruised pain from thighs to calves ; < on walking and when touched.
Paralytic weakness in left thigh and knee when stepping.
Pain in right knee, with burning and stiffness ; < when moving.
Violent pain in left knee and popliteal space.
Hard pressure in a space of two fingers' breadth below patella.
Pain in knees, as after a long march.
Giving away of knees when standing and walking.
Trembling of knees.
Weight in legs as if she could not step out, as if she had to drag a burden.
Weight in lower limbs. θ Bright's disease.
Her legs appear thicker and heavier ; fears dropsy.
Right leg as if paralyzed, feels as if weights were hung upon it. θ Acute rheumatism.
Coldness of legs, with loss of sensation.
Ankles painful, especially the right ; < moving.
Painful pressure on outside of ankle.
Stiffness of ankles.
Œdematous swelling about ankles.
Rose colored, elastic swelling of both ankle joints. θ Acute rheumatism.
Foot highly œdematous, most around ankle ; swelling a little reddened and hard over inner ankle. θ Acute rheumatism.
Eczematous eruption on right ankle, which is swollen, hot, red, moist and itching.
Feet feel as if paralyzed.
Cold feet. θ Affection of liver. θ Rheumatism.
Right foot cold as ice, left natural. θ Pneumonia.
Cramp in sole of right foot, which with toes is bent under ; < putting foot down ; > by compressing calf.
Itching in sole of right foot.
Stabbing, drawing pain at under side of left great toe.
Pain in fourth and fifth toes of right foot.
Toes without sensation, feel dead.
Intolerable pain in heels as if they had been pinched by too narrow a shoe.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Chel.]
Twitching in arms and legs.
Neuralgia in limbs. θ Bright's disease.
Rheumatism, least touch anywhere is exceedingly painful ; sweat without relief.
Drawing and paralytic feeling in limbs. θ Laryngitis.
Wandering pains in joints ; < left side and from motion.
Limbs : feel heavy, stiff and lame ; feel paralyzed ; cold.
Sudden uneasiness in all limbs ; must move about.
Trembling in limbs. θ Measles.
Œdematous swelling of limbs. θ Bright's disease.
Limbs flabby. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Cold extremities. θ Valvular disease.
Emaciated legs. θ Influenza.
Pain in all the limbs, with bruised sensation. θ Influenza.
Cutting pain in calves and upper arms, alternating with headache and preventing sleep. θ Epidemic typhus.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Chel.]
Rest : > coldness in occiput and nape ; > stitch pains.
Lying down : drawing in left malar bone.
Lying on face : > pain in kidneys and bladder.
Lying on left side : > pain in stomach.
Standing : knees give way.
Sitting up in bed : vertigo.
Stooping : < headache ; causes pressure in scrobiculum.
Stooping and bending back : cause sensation as if vertebræ were being torn apart.
Rising from a seat : pains in right hip.
Motion : disinclined to move, does so reluctantly ; < tearing in right temple ; < coldness in occiput and nape ; < pain in scrobiculum ; < pains in chest ; < pain in lower dorsal vertebræ ; < soreness in vertebræ ; of right arm < pain in shoulder and arm ; causes sensation as if left shoulder was breaking off ; < pain in right knee ; < pain in ankles ; > nervousness.
Walking : ringing in left ear ; < bruised pain from thighs to calves ; knees give way ; near falling asleep ; in open air, chill.
Walking rapidly : stitching in vertex.
When stepping : paralytic weakness in left thigh and knee.
Getting out of bed : loses her head ; vertigo.
Holding down head : < pain in right eye.
Looking up or moving eyes : causes aching in eyeballs.
Moving eyes : they pain as if sore.
Blowing nose : < headache.
Coughing : < headache.
Drawing up limbs : > pain in stomach.
Putting foot down : < cramp in sole of foot.
Slightest exertion : causes perspiration.
